findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded automatically by I18n.translate
findings.body: The new fallback support only loads fallback locale files when ApplicationController calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. The accelerated translate method still loads only config.locale, while the backend fallback module resolves fallback locales at the backend level and will not trigger load_locale for them. Any translation performed outside a controller request (background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, middleware, I18n.with_locale blocks, or explicit locale options) can therefore miss the fallback locale files and return missing translations instead of falling back.

findings.title: Translation cache key does not include the fallback default locale
findings.body: Fallbacks now depend on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the cache key only contains the translation key, current locale, and backend object id. If the site default locale is changed, cached translations that were stored as fallbacks for other locales are not invalidated by this PR, so stale strings from the previous default locale can continue to be served until the LRU entry expires or I18n is reloaded.

findings.title: Unsynchronized lazy initialization of @loaded_locales
findings.body: ensure_loaded! initializes the shared @loaded_locales array with ||= outside LOAD_MUTEX, while translate and load_locale access the same variable from multiple threads. Concurrent first calls can assign or observe different arrays, losing loaded-locale state and causing duplicate locale loads. translate also reads @loaded_locales without a nil guard.

findings.title: No tests for new global fallback behavior
findings.body: This changes I18n fallback behavior for all server-side translations and interacts with the lazy-loading and caching accelerator, but no tests are added to verify the fallback order, loading of fallback locale files, cache invalidation when the default locale changes, or behavior outside controller requests.
